Priscilla Reyes
priscilla.reyes@example.com | Albuquerque, NM
Priscilla Reyes has 7 years of experience in design. Most recently, Senior
Product Designer at Bellwood Studio (2024-2026), where they designed and
prototyped features in Figma used by 13+ engineers to build against. Before
that, Product Designer at Crestpoint Retail (2019-2024). Education: M.S. Fine
Arts, Northeastern University, 2019; B.A. Fine Arts, Metro State University,
2017. Core skills: Adobe XD, Visual design, Wireframing, Figma, UX research,
Design systems.
